name: MARA Young Talent Development Programme (YTP)
target_group: Bumiputera SPM Leavers (Special allocation for B40/Rural)
min_spm_requirements: Minimum 7A- depending on field (Sponsorship for local & overseas foundation/degree)
coverage: Full tuition fees, living allowance, flight tickets (for overseas), and laptop allowance
doc_required: SPM Result Slip, Parent MyKad, Income Slip / Village Head Endorsement Letter

name: Yayasan Peneraju Professional Accounting / Tech Schemes
target_group: Bumiputera B40 & Rural Youth pursuing Professional Certifications (ACCA, Data, Tech)
min_spm_requirements: 5 Credits including Mathematics and Bahasa Melayu
household_income_cap: B40 (< RM 4,850) and M40 primary focus
coverage: 100% Full tuition fees, examination fees, monthly living allowance, and job placement coaching
doc_required: SPM Certificate, Household Income Verification, Birth Certificate

name: MyPAC Professional Accounting Sponsorship
target_group: B40 & Underprivileged post-SPM students aiming for ACCA / CAT / FIA
min_spm_requirements: Minimum 5As including A in Mathematics and English
coverage: Full tuition fees, ACCA exam fees, hostel accommodation, monthly stipend, and mentoring
doc_required: SPM Slip, EA Form / Borang J / Surat Pengesahan Pendapatan Ketua Kampung

name: Biasiswa Program Khas JPA (B40 & Luar Bandar)
coverage: Full tuition fee, monthly living allowance (RM800), laptop allowance
doc_required: SPM Result Slip, Verification of Income (EA Form / Ketua Kampung Letter)

name: Yayasan Sarawak / Sabah B40 Higher Education Sponsorship
target_group: B40 Students residing in Sabah & Sarawak
min_spm_requirements: 3As and above in SPM or Pass SPM for TVET entries
coverage: Full tuition + semester allowance + flight ticket subsidies
doc_required: State IC (K/K status), Household Income Verification, SPM Slip
